beats.title: Osman Founds the Ottoman Beylik
beats.description: A frontier warlord in northwest Anatolia declares his small principality independent, planting the seed of a great empire.
beats.note: Traditional founding date; scholars debate it.

beats.title: Orhan Captures Bursa
beats.description: After a long siege the Ottomans take a rich Byzantine city and make it their first great capital.

beats.title: Ottomans Seize Gallipoli
beats.description: After an earthquake wrecks its walls, an Ottoman force occupies a fortress on the European shore of the Dardanelles.

beats.title: Battle of Kosovo
beats.description: Ottoman forces defeat a Serbian-led coalition on the plains of the Balkans, and both rulers die in the fighting.

beats.title: Crusaders Crushed at Nicopolis
beats.description: A large Christian army sent to drive the Ottomans from Europe is routed on the Danube by Sultan Bayezid.

beats.title: Timur Defeats Bayezid at Ankara
beats.description: A Central Asian conqueror captures the Ottoman sultan in battle, plunging the young state into civil war.

beats.title: Battle of Varna
beats.description: A young sultan crushes a Hungarian-Polish crusading army on the Black Sea coast, ending hopes of rescuing Byzantium.

beats.title: Mehmed II Takes Constantinople
beats.description: After a siege with giant cannon, the Ottomans storm the walls and end the thousand-year Byzantine Empire.

beats.title: Topkapi Palace Completed
beats.description: The conqueror of Constantinople finishes a vast palace on the Bosphorus headland that will house sultans for centuries.
beats.note: Construction began 1459; core complex dated 1465; some sources run work to 1478.

beats.title: Sultan Welcomes Sephardic Jews
beats.description: Bayezid II invites Jews driven out of Spain to settle across his lands, enriching Ottoman cities.

beats.title: Battle of Chaldiran
beats.description: Ottoman guns and Janissaries defeat the Safavid cavalry of Persia in eastern Anatolia.

beats.title: Selim I Conquers Egypt
beats.description: The Ottomans overthrow the Mamluk sultanate in Cairo, gaining control of the holy cities of Arabia.

beats.title: Suleiman Takes the Throne
beats.description: The tenth sultan begins a long reign that will bring the empire to its greatest strength and splendour.

beats.title: Battle of Mohacs
beats.description: Ottoman artillery wipes out the Hungarian royal army in under two hours, killing the young king.

beats.title: Suleiman Enters Baghdad
beats.description: Ottoman forces seize the old Abbasid capital from the Persians and add Mesopotamia to the empire.

beats.title: Battle of Preveza
beats.description: Barbarossa's Ottoman fleet beats a Holy League armada off the Greek coast, securing control of the Mediterranean.

beats.title: First Coffeehouses Open
beats.description: Syrian merchants open the city's first public coffee shops, creating a new social space that spreads across Europe.

beats.title: Suleymaniye Mosque Completed
beats.description: The architect Sinan finishes a giant domed mosque complex crowning one of Constantinople's hills.

beats.title: Suleiman Dies at Szigetvar
beats.description: The aged sultan dies during a campaign in Hungary, and his death is hidden from the army for weeks.

beats.title: Ottomans Invade Cyprus
beats.description: A large Ottoman force lands on the Venetian island, taking Nicosia and then Famagusta after a bitter siege.

beats.title: Blue Mosque Completed
beats.description: Sultan Ahmed I's six-minaret mosque, tiled in blue, rises opposite Hagia Sophia in the capital.

beats.title: Treaty of Karlowitz
beats.description: The Ottomans cede Hungary and Transylvania to the Habsburgs, their first major territorial loss in a peace treaty.

beats.title: The Tulip Era Begins
beats.description: After a peace treaty, the court turns to leisure, gardens, French fashions and a craze for tulips.
beats.note: Begins with the Treaty of Passarowitz.

beats.title: First Ottoman Printed Book
beats.description: Ibrahim Muteferrika produces the first Turkish-language book on a press in the capital, after long resistance.

beats.title: Treaty of Kucuk Kaynarca
beats.description: Defeat by Russia costs the Ottomans the Crimean Khanate and gives the tsar a claim to protect Orthodox subjects.

beats.title: Selim III Becomes Sultan
beats.description: A reform-minded ruler takes the throne and soon sets about building a European-style army, the New Order, to rival the old corps.
beats.note: Accession 7 April 1789; the Nizam-i Cedid reforms came 1792-93.

beats.title: Muhammad Ali Governs Egypt
beats.description: An Albanian officer is confirmed as the Ottoman governor of Egypt and builds a near-independent modern state there.

beats.title: Greek War of Independence Begins
beats.description: An uprising in the Peloponnese and Danubian lands starts a long war that will end Ottoman rule in Greece.

beats.title: Janissaries Abolished
beats.description: Sultan Mahmud II destroys the rebellious elite infantry corps in the Auspicious Incident, clearing the way for reform.

beats.title: Tanzimat Reforms Proclaimed
beats.description: The Edict of Gulhane promises security of life and property and equal treatment for all subjects of the sultan.

beats.title: Crimean War Begins
beats.description: The Ottomans declare war on Russia, and Britain and France soon join them in a conflict over the Black Sea.
beats.note: Ottoman declaration of war in October 1853.

beats.title: Reform Edict Promises Equality
beats.description: A sultan's decree grants non-Muslim subjects equal rights, as the Ottomans join the European diplomatic order.

beats.title: First Ottoman Constitution
beats.description: A new sultan promulgates a written constitution and an elected parliament, which he soon suspends.

beats.title: Congress of Berlin
beats.description: European powers meet to revise a harsh peace with Russia, recognising Serbia, Montenegro and Romania as independent.

beats.title: Young Turk Revolution
beats.description: Officers of the Committee of Union and Progress force the sultan to restore the suspended constitution.

beats.title: Abdulhamid II Deposed
beats.description: After a failed countercoup, parliament removes the long-ruling sultan and replaces him with a figurehead brother.

beats.title: Ottomans Enter the Great War
beats.description: Two warships bombard Russian Black Sea ports, bringing the empire into the world war on the side of Germany.

beats.title: Armistice of Mudros
beats.description: Defeated, the Ottomans sign a ceasefire aboard a British warship, opening the way to Allied occupation of the capital.

beats.title: Ottoman Sultanate Abolished
beats.description: The Turkish national assembly votes to end the sultanate, and the last ruler leaves the capital aboard a British ship.

beats.title: Caliphate Abolished
beats.description: The Turkish republic's assembly ends the Ottoman dynasty's religious office and sends the family into exile.
